bandwidth.title: Bandwidth
bandwidth.info: How much information a channel can carry per second. Widen the pipe; throughput climbs. Compare a neuron, fiber optic, and Eywa's root net.

basal-cognition.title: Basal Cognition
basal-cognition.info: Mind without a brain. Place food and obstacles; the slime mold grows, samples, and solves the maze by morphology alone.

bit.title: Bit
bit.info: One binary choice = exactly one bit. Flip each switch; stack them to encode a larger message. Uncertainty halved each flip.

channel-capacity.title: Channel Capacity
channel-capacity.info: Shannon's ceiling: C = B log₂(1+S/N). Raise noise; the reliable rate drops. Packets above the limit scatter.

cognitive-light-cone.title: Cognitive Light Cone
cognitive-light-cone.info: The space-time volume an agent can sense and act on. Raise sophistication; the cone widens from a cell's bubble to a planet-mind.

conscious-bottleneck.title: Conscious Bottleneck
conscious-bottleneck.info: Many parallel streams, one serial spotlight. Add sensory inputs; only a few cross the bottleneck at once. Attention is the gate.

distributed-cognition.title: Distributed Cognition
distributed-cognition.info: Thinking spans heads, tools, and place. Toggle notebook, teammate, or whiteboard offline; collective capacity falls. Mind is not only skull-bound.
distributed-cognition.head: Head

global-workspace-theory.title: Global Workspace
global-workspace-theory.info: Unconscious modules compete; the winner is broadcast on the lit stage. Inject a stimulus and watch the spotlight shift.

hard-problem-of-consciousness.title: Hard Problem
hard-problem-of-consciousness.info: Map every spike and synapse — the objective side fills in. The subjective 'what it is like' stays unbridged. That gap is the hard problem.

information-theory.title: Information Theory
information-theory.info: Message → encode → noisy channel → decode. Type a short string; watch compression, corruption, and recovery. Entropy and redundancy meters live.

integrated-information-theory.title: Integrated Information
integrated-information-theory.info: Φ scores how much a system is more than its parts. Wire nodes together; integrated + differentiated nets rise. A disconnected pile scores ~0.

noisy-channel-coding-theorem.title: Noisy-Channel Coding
noisy-channel-coding-theorem.info: Shannon: any rate below capacity can be made arbitrarily reliable. Pick a coding rate; green below C, red above — errors explode past the boundary.

shannon-entropy.title: Shannon Entropy
shannon-entropy.info: Average surprise of a source. Skew the symbol probabilities; H peaks when all are equal, drops to zero when one is certain.

signal-to-noise-ratio.title: Signal-to-Noise
signal-to-noise-ratio.info: Clean waveform under rising noise floor. Lift noise; SNR falls and the signal drowns past a recovery threshold. Ties straight to channel capacity.

functionalism.title: Functionalism
functionalism.info: Same function, three substrates: neurons, silicon, root-net. Feed identical input; all three emit the same output. Toggle 'anyone home?' for the qualia objection.

panpsychism.title: Panpsychism
panpsychism.info: Zoom galaxy → brain → atom → electron. Each level keeps a faint spark. Panpsychism: experience is fundamental. Flip to emergentism and sparks appear only at brains.

teleology.title: Teleology
teleology.info: Heart beats because selection shaped it, or in order to pump? Sort claims onto mechanism vs purpose. Daisyworld regulates without goals.
